verdict.rationale: CrewAI's core architecture is explicitly built for multi-agent orchestration: Agents, Tasks, and Crews collaborate with sequential/hierarchical processes and delegation, plus Flows for event-driven coordination across multiple crews/tasks (crewai-docs-3,4,20,21,35,36,46,48). A hands-on community build (Gmail triage agent with multiple collaborating CrewAI agents) corroborates real-world multi-agent use (crewai-comm-1), and a competitor's critique concerns guardrails/state persistence, not whether orchestration works at all (crewai-comm-4). missing for 10: independent large-scale benchmarking of complex multi-crew handoffs beyond docs and one hands-on example.
